openFindings.title: Residue gate misses camelCase transport identifiers
openFindings.description: Expand the gate and classify/remove live variants.
openFindings.scopeProof: Live openDesign/OPEN_DESIGN hits exist outside the deleted tree and are not matched by the acceptance regex.

openFindings.title: Inventory omits live mcp-tooling discovery fixtures
openFindings.description: Add the fixtures to the inventory or explicitly classify them historical and amend the gate.
openFindings.scopeProof: Aside, Refero, and Mobbin discovery fixtures contain open_design tool names but are absent from the plan table/exclusions.

openFindings.title: NFR-S01 lacks explicit env/path/token residue assertion
openFindings.scopeProof: Prior security sweep found no independent assertion for retired env/path/token identifiers.

openFindings.title: Claimed checklist items have no pinned evidence
openFindings.scopeProof: Prior traceability audit found checked rows without evidence links and later evidence rows unchecked.

openFindings.title: T032 lacks an executable complete derived-manifest regeneration contract
openFindings.scopeProof: T022 lists leaf-manifest, mode-registry, hub-router, and command-metadata while T032 provides no command, artifact classification, or parity assertion.

openFindings.title: Promised deprecation changelog entry is not task-mapped
openFindings.scopeProof: Spec requests an append-only deprecation entry, but Phase 2 tasks T022/T030 contain no changelog task/file; current changelog hits are historical.

openFindings.title: Live-surface exclusion allowlist is prose-only and not reproducible
openFindings.scopeProof: Plan defines git ls-files minus prose categories and T010 says freeze in scratch, but no format, path, hash/count, or reuse command is specified.

openFindings.title: Live-render playbook and catalog use a dispatch token the executable adapter rejects
openFindings.description: Documented payload uses design-mcp-open-design, while executable constant/rejection requires sk-design-mcp-open-design; live run returned dispatch-boundary-violation.
openFindings.scopeProof: Exact token was checked in implementation, catalogs, playbook, and companion test; documented CLI payload was executed.

openFindings.title: Dedicated design-generation reference is not classified for deletion
openFindings.scopeProof: Full file review shows every substantive section is tied to the retired transport; no delete or generic rewrite contract exists.

openFindings.title: Advisor retains retired transport-specific intent boosters and T029 has no entry-level corpus disposition
openFindings.scopeProof: Direct variant search found six live scorer entries and the transport comment; direct graph search found no sk-design-mcp-open-design entry, separating scorer residue from graph routing.

openFindings.title: Sk-doc frozen README and directory fixtures encode the deleted tree and are consumed as live test inputs
openFindings.scopeProof: The two test scripts explicitly read the two focus fixtures and compare/execute against their paths; deleted paths are present in both fixture families.

openFindings.title: Sk-doc validator, agent template, and parent-skill reference hardcode the retired packet beyond T028 named fixture scope
openFindings.scopeProof: The exact package ID occurs in executable validator data and the exact route occurs in two shipped documentation templates; these are distinct from the baseline/manifest snapshot paths in P1-011.

openFindings.title: System-spec-kit live workflow contract and link-integrity evidence are not fully in the deprecation inventory
openFindings.scopeProof: One live workflow contract is outside the named system-spec paths and one active playbook evidence block contains the old transport path; the plan table was checked for the missing workflow path.

openFindings.title: System-spec-kit ground-truth source and dist copies are live eval data but T028 lacks a paired regeneration/parity contract
openFindings.scopeProof: Both tracked copies were parsed and compared; the source loader and build script were read; both copies contain the same retired query rows and live-eval notes.

openFindings.title: Live Lane-C fixture gold is omitted from the deprecation inventory and retains retired transport identifiers
openFindings.description: The live public/private fixture loader consumes explicit fixture directories; the central corpus loaded 43 sk_design rows with zero errors and 42 private-gold rows retain retired transport labels or payload fields.
openFindings.scopeProof: loadFixtures recursively discovers public/private pairs; the full central corpus was loaded and the variant sweep found retired labels in dispatch and alias gold rather than one isolated file.

openFindings.title: Live .claude MCP configuration is omitted from the deprecation inventory
openFindings.scopeProof: Corrected whole-workspace sweep found the exact config as an unmatched hit; direct reread confirmed open_design and retired OD_ env-name entries.

openFindings.title: Cursor and Devin runtime agents/commands are outside the cross-runtime removal inventory
openFindings.scopeProof: Corrected sweep found five Cursor files and two Devin agent files outside every plan prefix; direct reads confirmed active design-agent mode maps and a Cursor command reference.

openFindings.title: Advisor manual-testing playbooks retain transport paths beyond T029's named corpus files
openFindings.scopeProof: Three exact live advisor playbook files were found by corrected variant sweep outside T029's exact scorer/graph paths; auto-indexing corpus explicitly lists the transport packet path.

openFindings.title: Root CLAUDE.md is omitted from root-document cleanup
openFindings.scopeProof: Corrected whole-workspace sweep found CLAUDE.md:526 as an unmatched root hit; direct reread shows an active workflow reference table, not a historical record.
